errors.text: The strain-rate regime is reconstructed as 10^-4–10^3 s^-1 rather than the molecular-dynamics range of 10^8–10^10 s^-1, changing the relevant kinetics and boundary of the claim.
The onset mechanism is attributed primarily to bulk thermally activated glide and solute-drag barriers rather than dislocation nucleation at vacancy clusters or disordered sites.
The hypothesis omits Shockley partial dislocations and intrinsic/extrinsic stacking faults, which are the principal deformation mediators in the target.
The required orientation dependence is not reconstructed: the tested <110>, <1-12>, and <-111> axes and the maximum yield stress along <-111> are absent.
